verdict.rationale: EBANX's pay-in guide documents a no-code option where payments are created in the EBANX dashboard and shared with customers through a link. That covers the core of creating a shareable payment link without code. The evidence is a single one-line description, though, and nothing shows a founder can start selling immediately. missing for 10: evidence of immediate go-live (onboarding, account approval or activation time), detail on payment-link configuration (reusable vs. one-off links, amounts, payment methods), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: No-code solution where payments are created via the EBANX dashboard and shared directly with customers through a link.
